meta.title: Steel Valley Long Range - Long-Range Sport Shooting Range
meta.description: Steel Valley Long Range is a professional long-range sport shooting range. We offer shooting training, competitions and courses for sport shooting enthusiasts.

hero.lead: A 1000 m shooting lane for long-range shooters from all over Europe.

about.todo: TODO(owner): replace the description of the range and the 1000 m lane, and the photo (src/assets/photos/). Current texts and illustration are placeholders.
about.lead: Steel Valley Long Range is a shooting range built for long-range shooting: a 1000-metre lane and a target field with steel targets.
about.body: Steel targets placed at various distances allow training and competitions over the full length of the lane. An additional 100-metre lane is also available. Electronic targets will be available in the future as well.
about.imageAlt: Placeholder illustration: a shooting lane between earth berms with steel targets in the target field

disciplines.intro: The 1000 m lane and steel targets support a range of long-range shooting disciplines. A moving target and electronic targets will also be available soon.

items.name: Precision Rifle (PRS)
items.description: Precision shooting from various positions and supports at steel targets over changing distances, under time pressure.

items.name: NRL Hunter
items.description: NRL Hunter is a field-shooting sport built around realistic hunting scenarios. Steel targets at unknown distances are engaged from natural field positions, using the very same skills that make a capable, ethical hunter.

items.name: Sharpshooter Challenge
items.description: A military approach to long-range shooting. Shooting at known and unknown distances, moving targets, and a variety of positions adapted to the terrain.

items.name: F-Class
items.description: Precision prone shooting from a rest at long distances.

items.name: Training and courses
items.description: Sessions for shooters who want to start or develop their long-range shooting skills in any form. Best-in-class instructors.
